'''Custodian Lambert''' is a [[human]] located at [[Amberwood Keep]] in [[Northwind]]. At a council meeting with [[Lord Amberwood]], [[Sir Hans Dale]] and [[Rutherford Justino]], it was at his behest that Lord Amberwood send word out to any adventurers who could aid Northwind in the dark hours of the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] and [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron]] incursions.<ref name="1.18 trailer" />

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Watch your manners and respect the queue. Cutting in line won't get you a quicker audience with Lord Amberwood!

==Notes and trivia==
* Custodian Lambert is the narrator for the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vIuS0DXGY6Y Northwind Zone Trailer], and is voiced by [https://www.youtube.com/@HarryDoolanActs Harry Doolan].
